Name: Stardew Radio for Joja Mart and Hospital
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[size=5]📻 [b]WELCOME TO STARDEW RADIO![/b] 🎵[/size]

Ever walk into JojaMart or Harvey’s Clinic and immediately notice how [i]quiet[/i] they are?

[b]Stardew Radio[/b] adds soft, retro store-radio music to both locations, giving them the kind of pleasantly bland background tunes you’d expect to hear drifting from a ceiling speaker while shopping for groceries or waiting for your yearly checkup. ✨

[center]📻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━📻[/center]

[size=4]✨ [b]MOD FEATURES[/b] ✨[/size]

🛒 [b]Music inside JojaMart![/b]
Adds a looping background track while you wander the fluorescent aisles of everyone’s favorite corporate nightmare.

🩺 [b]Music inside Harvey’s Clinic![/b]
Enjoy some appropriately inoffensive waiting-room tunes while Harvey reminds you that healthcare is expensive.

🏠 [b]Location-specific audio![/b]
The music only plays where it’s supposed to. It does [b]not[/b] affect Harvey’s upstairs apartment or the Abandoned JojaMart.

🔁 [b]Seamless looping![/b]
The track loops continuously while you’re inside without awkward gaps between plays.

🎶 [b]Uses Stardew Valley’s native audio system![/b]
No Custom Music framework required!

🪶 [b]Lightweight and simple![/b]
Stardew Radio is a Content Patcher mod and doesn’t modify maps, NPCs, schedules, dialogue, shops, or gameplay.

[center]📻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━📻[/center]

[size=4]🎵 [b]THE MUSIC[/b] 🎵[/size]

Stardew Radio uses [b]“Shop Theme” by Cleyton Kauffman[/b].

The version included with the mod has been given a slightly muffled radio effect to make it sound like the music is actually playing through an old store or waiting-room speaker. 📻

🎼 [url=https://opengameart.org/content/shop-theme][b]Original music source[/b][/url]

📜 [url=https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/][b]CC0 1.0 Universal License[/b][/url]

The track was released under [b]CC0 1.0 Universal[/b], meaning it can be freely used, modified, redistributed, and used commercially. Credit isn’t legally required under CC0, but a huge thank you to [b]Cleyton Kauffman[/b] for making the track available! 💕

[center]📻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━📻[/center]

[size=4]🎥 [b]STREAMER FRIENDLY[/b] 🎥[/size]

Planning to stream or record your farm? You’re good to go! 🌱 The included music is released under [b]CC0[/b], it can legally be used in monetized streams and videos and redistributed as part of this mod.

Automated copyright systems can occasionally decide to wake up and choose violence, so no audio track can be guaranteed completely immune to an erroneous Content ID claim. However, the CC0 license provides clear permission for commercial use, modification, and redistribution.

[center]📻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━📻[/center]

[size=4]📥 [b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b] 📥[/size]

You’ll need:

🌱 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]

🔧 [b]SMAPI[/b]

🧩 [b]Content Patcher[/b]

Once those are installed, simply extract [b]Stardew Radio[/b] into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch the game through SMAPI.

Then head into JojaMart or Harvey’s Clinic and enjoy the aggressively pleasant background music. 📻✨

[center]📻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━📻[/center]

[size=4]🧩 [b]COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/b] 🧩[/size]

Stardew Radio changes the music settings for:

🛒 [b]JojaMart[/b]

🩺 [b]Hospital / Harvey’s Clinic[/b]

Mods that also change the music assigned to these locations may override Stardew Radio or be overridden by it depending on how the mods are loaded.

It does [b]not[/b] modify the actual location maps, NPCs, schedules, dialogue, shops, or other gameplay systems, so mods changing those should generally be unaffected.

If you find a music mod that doesn’t play nicely with Stardew Radio, compatibility patch requests are welcome! 💕
